svg.title: Flash-drum trial at 300 kPa: K at the converged T = 55.4 °C
svg.text: Flash-drum trial at 300 kPa: K at the converged T = 55.4 °C
High-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark p = 300 kPa on the pressure scale (left).
Mark a trial T on the right scale (converged: 55.4 °C; dashed: 50 and 57 °C).
Join the two marks with a straight edge.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
